errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.request: That request could not be completed.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.validation: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.modelNotAllowed: That embedding model is not on the allowed list. Reload the page and pick one from the list.

page.title: FAQ engine
page.description: Controls how every workspace's FAQs are matched to customer messages: the switch, the embedding model, the limits and the health of the index.
page.superOnly: Only a super admin can see or change the FAQ engine.

engine.title: Engine
engine.hintOn: {count, plural, one {# workspace has FAQs switched on} other {# workspaces have FAQs switched on}}
engine.hintOff: No workspace is answering from FAQs and edits are blocked.

key.title: Platform OpenRouter key
key.explainReady: Workspaces that have not saved their own OpenRouter key use this one to make and match vectors.
key.explainMissing: Workspaces that have not saved their own OpenRouter key depend on this one. Without it they cannot make vectors, and matching falls back to spelling similarity.
key.link: Add the key in AI provider keys

index.title: Indexing health
index.stale: {count, plural, one {# vector belongs to an older model and matches nothing until it is re-embedded} other {# vectors belong to an older model and match nothing until they are re-embedded}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Applies to every workspace. Only the fields you change are saved.

engine.label: FAQ engine
engine.hint: Turn it off to stop every workspace from answering from FAQs. Edits are blocked while it is off.

embeddingModel.label: Embedding model
embeddingModel.hint: Turns each question into numbers so similar wording can be found.
embeddingModel.details: {dimensions, number} dimensions · {price} per million tokens · suggested threshold {threshold}

generationModel.label: Generation model
generationModel.hint: The OpenRouter model id that writes variation suggestions, for example openai/gpt-4o-mini.

threshold.label: Default match threshold
threshold.hint: A message matches when its score is at least this. Only used by flows that never saved their own threshold. Scores depend on the embedding model.
threshold.followHint: The default sensitivity is the model's recommended value ({value}) and moves when the model changes. Turn off to fix a number.

limits.title: Limits
limits.semanticPerHour: Semantic matches per workspace per hour
limits.semanticPerHourHint: Past this, a workspace falls back to spelling similarity for the rest of the hour. 0 means always spelling similarity.
limits.verifyPerHour: Second checks per workspace per hour

errors.modelId: Use an OpenRouter model id such as openai/gpt-4o-mini.

settings.changed: {count, plural, one {# change ready to save} other {# changes ready to save}}

confirm.title: Review before saving
confirm.engineOff: Turning the engine off stops every workspace from answering customers from FAQs and blocks FAQ edits until you turn it back on.
confirm.modelChange: Changing the embedding model from {from} to {to} makes every stored vector again. Until that finishes, matching uses spelling similarity only. The default sensitivity will follow the new model (recommended {threshold}) unless you set a fixed value. Thresholds that flows saved on their own may need retuning because scores change with the model.

verify.title: Second check for close calls
verify.description: A small chat model double-checks matches that only just reached a flow's bar. It can only withhold an answer. Flows switch it on in their own FAQ settings.

enabled.label: Allow the second check
enabled.hint: Turn it off to stop the check for every workspace, whatever they set.

model.label: Check model
model.hint: The OpenRouter model id that judges close calls, for example openai/gpt-4o-mini. A small, fast model is enough.

verify.perHourHint: Past this, a close call stands unchecked for the rest of the hour. 0 means never check.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Re-embed the index when something looks wrong. The work runs in the background.
maintenance.polling: Refreshing every 5 seconds while {count, number} are waiting.
maintenance.idle: Nothing is waiting to be indexed.

confirmAll.title: Re-index everything?
confirmAll.message: Every stored vector is made again with the current model. Matching uses spelling similarity for the rows that are not ready yet, and embedding tokens are billed again.

confirmFailed.title: Retry the failed vectors?
confirmFailed.message: Only the vectors that gave up are queued again. Check the platform OpenRouter key first if they keep failing.

maintenance.queued: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to queue.} one {# vector queued.} other {# vectors queued.}}

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Busiest first. Switched-on workspaces come before the rest.
workspaces.emptyMessage: Workspaces appear here once they exist.
workspaces.noMatchMessage: Check the spelling or clear the search box.
